title: Cybersecurity incident affects EURR token operations
description: StablR identified irregularities consistent with unauthorized external access, suspended minting and redemption, and disclosed that circulating EURR and USDR supply was not fully backed at the required 1:1 ratio after the incident.
notes: Official disclosure published 25 May 2026 describes the incident as identified on 24 May 2026.

title: Cybersecurity incident affects USDR token operations
description: StablR identified irregularities consistent with unauthorized external access, suspended minting and redemption, and disclosed that circulating EURR and USDR supply was not fully backed at the required 1:1 ratio after the incident.
notes: Official disclosure published 25 May 2026 describes the incident as identified on 24 May 2026.

title: StablR activates Recovery Plan for EURR
description: StablR formally activated its Recovery Plan, notified and engaged the MFSA, kept minting and redemption suspended, and requested continued exchange and venue suspensions while forensic and recovery work proceeded.
notes: The 5 June update confirmed that minting and redemption remained suspended and that conditions and timing for lifting suspensions were still under review.

title: StablR activates Recovery Plan for USDR

title: StablR reports EURR incident containment while suspension continues
description: StablR reported that the immediate incident had been contained, affected minting controls had been secured, and no further unauthorized issuance had occurred since 24 May, while minting and redemption remained suspended as a precaution.
notes: Containment is not treated as full service recovery because the same update says minting and redemption remain suspended.
